text:
sam: Heads-up: We're planning a blue/green cutover tonight during the 23:00-00:00 UTC change window. Need router/LB plan, pinning, and rollback criteria.
maria: Thanks — can we do a staged tranche: 5% canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m watches between? Keep sticky session pin for 30m to avoid weird user jumps.
lee: Agree on tranches. For router changes: set session affinity cookie TTL to 1h and enable route pinning for the new pool until forced drain completes.
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled swap at 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z
maria: Deploy command I'm going to run:
```bash
deploy schedule --env=prod --at=2026-03-20T23:00:00Z --strategy=blue-green --from=v2.2.9 --to=v2.3.1-rc5 --pin-router=true --canary=5%
```
sam: Rollback triggers: error rate >3% across any region for 5m OR p95 latency +50% from baseline OR model output regression >2% on sentinel evals.
lee: Add health-check probe: /_ready fast-check + /_smoke that runs a small prompt eval hitting the inference cache to detect regressions quickly.
ops-bot: Note: LB drain window 15m per backend, allow 2x warmup spike headroom. If we see >20% 5xx or tail latency spike, trigger rollback.
maria: Also pin traffic on the router level: allow pin label "v2.3-pin" so we can hold cohorts if needed. Config snippet:
```yaml
router:
  pins:
    - name: v2.3-pin
      selector: cookie:session
      ttl: 3600
``` 
sam: Good. Who's watching metrics? @lee and @maria will be on call, @sam on pager if anything crosses thresholds.
maria: I'll post a quick release note in #announcements after completion.
lee: I'll run a quick preflight check at 22:30 UTC: run smoke, perf probe, and token-gen regression on a small set.
sam: OK start time 23:00 UTC. If no critical signals by 23:40 we'll continue ramp to 100%.
maria: If we need to rollback, deploy-bot rollback command:
```bash
deploy run rollback --env=prod --to=v2.2.9 --force-policy=immediate
```
ops-bot: Reminder: update incident channel if we flip to rollback.
sam: thanks, let's keep messages here for the operator log. :thumbsup:
maria: acknowledged :white_check_mark:
lee: I'll be on watch + live metrics dashboard open.
deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2026-03-20T23:00:12Z (canary 5%)
maria: canary looks clean at +3m
lee: p95 and error rate stable, proceeding to 25% in 10m
ops-bot: traffic shifted to 25% at 2026-03-20T23:13:30Z
sam: monitoring
maria: all green, proceed to 50%
ops-bot: traffic shifted to 50% at 2026-03-20T23:25:00Z
lee: minor tail increase in eu-west p99, watching. not breaching thresholds yet.
maria: holding for 10m
sam: if p99 crosses threshold we pause and start partial pin on cohorts.
maria: 23:40 -> moving to 100%
ops-bot: traffic shifted to 100% at 2026-03-20T23:41:05Z
lee: new pool warm and drains completing. no rollback needed.
sam: closing thread, will add release note. Good job team :tada:
